Teardown

A heist and destruction game set in fully destructible voxel levels where the player plans a route by cutting, smashing, and driving through structures, then races a 60-second alarm timer to grab the targets.

2020Tuxedo LabsPhysics sandboxcluster c078 mechanics
this record asyaml sourcemarkdownjson

core loop

survey the level -> cut, blast, and ram a route through voxel structures -> stage vehicles and ramps -> trigger the alarm by taking a target -> grab the rest along the planned path before the timer ends

design notes

Every object is made of small voxels with material types (wood, plaster, brick, metal, glass), and disconnected chunks become rigid bodies that fall, roll, and burn, so geometry is a resource the player spends. The design separates an unlimited planning phase from a timed execution phase: picking up a connected target starts a 60-second alarm, so the player engineers shortcuts with tools, explosives, and vehicles before the first grab. Materials resist tools differently, and fire spreads through wood, which turns construction knowledge into route planning.

relations

8 stored edges
uses

Crisis countdown

In most heists taking an alarmed target starts a 60-second timer to reach the getaway vehicle, so the route must be prepared during an unlimited setup phase.

core
uses

Rigid-body physics

Voxel chunks cut loose become dynamic bodies with mass that fall, roll, and crush; vehicles and cranes push and lift them.

core
uses

Voxel destruction

Levels are made of small voxels whose material sets which tools can break them; the sledgehammer breaks soft materials, the blowtorch cuts metal, and explosives remove volumes.

core
uses

Fire spread

Fire spreads across wood and other flammables and can burn targets or open routes; burning structures weaken and fall.

supporting
uses

Material interactions

Materials respond differently to each tool and to fire; a fire extinguisher puts fires out.

supporting
uses

Modding API

Lua scripting, a level editor, and Steam Workshop support custom levels, tools, and modes.

supporting
uses

Scenario objectives

40 campaign missions specify targets, optional targets, and conditions such as stealing, destroying, or collecting evidence.

supporting
uses

Structural integrity

Sections cut off from all supports fall, so removing pillars can drop a floor.
